divine mothers drawn by the stated powers
qualifies the mothers and yogeśvarīs as a complete group
sandhi form of yogeśvaryaḥ; nominative plural subject alongside mothers

items.question: By what agency are all the mothers and yogeśvarīs drawn in their great power?
premises: The triad functions as an active drawing agency.
All mothers are included among those drawn.
The yogeśvarīs are included and possess great power.
items.inference: The triad draws all the mothers and the greatly powerful yogeśvarīs.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the triad is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: By the triad, all the mothers and the greatly powerful yogeśvarīs are drawn.
